featured_reviews.name: vinayak parab
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently had the pleasure of visiting Automobile & Electric Garage for some car maintenance and electrical repairs, and I must say, the experience exceeded all my expectations. From start to finish, the team at this garage demonstrated a level of professionalism, knowledge, and customer service that truly impressed me.

First and foremost, the staff at Automobile & Electric Garage are incredibly skilled and knowledgeable in their field. They possess a deep understanding of both traditional combustion engines and cutting-edge electric vehicle technology. No matter the complexity of the issue, they confidently tackled every problem and provided effective solutions. Their expertise gave me confidence that my vehicle was in the right hands.

Moreover, the level of customer service I received was exceptional. The staff members were friendly, approachable, and took the time to listen to my concerns. They patiently explained the repairs needed and provided transparent pricing information, ensuring that I fully understood the work that was being done on my car. This level of transparency and open communication instilled a sense of trust and made me feel like a valued customer.

Another aspect that impressed me was the efficiency and timeliness of their service. The team at Automobile & Electric Garage understood the importance of getting my car back on the road as quickly as possible. They promptly diagnosed the issues, and the repairs were completed in a timely manner without sacrificing quality. This attention to detail and dedication to customer satisfaction set them apart from other garages I've visited in the past.

In addition to their technical expertise and outstanding customer service, the facilities at Automobile & Electric Garage were top-notch. The garage was clean, well-organized, and equipped with the latest tools and diagnostic equipment. It was evident that they invested in maintaining a modern and efficient workspace, which further instilled confidence in their abilities.

Overall, I highly recommend Automobile & Electric Garage to anyone in need of automotive repairs or maintenance. Their exceptional service, expertise, and commitment to customer satisfaction make them a standout choice. Whether you own a traditional vehicle or an electric car, you can trust that your vehicle will receive the utmost care and attention at this garage. I will definitely be returning to Automobile & Electric Garage for all my future automotive needs.

featured_reviews.name: Rahul Kalyanpur
featured_reviews.review_text:
"CHEATERS" it the word which comes to my mind when I hear the name MAYUR ELECTRONICS of Lamington Road. I had been to the shop to buy a WIFI ROUTER. I being a layman was not aware of different types routers available in the market. I use an MTNL service at home and I had some issues with the router hence I visited the the Lamington road to buy a new router for my self. The store Owner said the prices are fixed and cannot be bargained. He sold me a TP link router for Rs 950/-. He never informed me the router for MTNL is different and different for other service provider. I got the router home and asked the MTNL person to install the same. The MTNL person informed me that the router is not compatible for MTNL. I had to go all the way back to Lamington road to replace and take a router compatible with MTNL. The person at the Mayur Electronics said he does not have one that supports MTNL. I asked for a refund on which he said there will be a deduction of Rs 150 if I ask for a refund and was very rude to talk. They wasted almost an hour of mine at the store on Saturday the 14th Dec 2019. I reached the store around 1 pm and waited at the store for almost an hour first to just because they wanted to check with someone if the ADSL router was available. The owner was very busy getting his horoscope checked with a pandit who had visited the store. And the employees were very much interested to listen the horoscope of their boss instead of attending the customers.

Pathetic store. Better I would have availed the product online. If it is not compatible atleast they refund the amount.

I have taken an oath today that I will never ever buy any product from this store even if it would be the only store supplying any product that I might be in need of.

"Bloody cheaters"
